purpose: Prevent collider/selection and denominator bias when estimating insect approaches per minute, and distinguish genuine verified zero events from missing/camera blind spots. Complements, never replaces, EAzami Aim2 bout and head outcome records.
rules: Exactly one duration-defined video effort row for each head × bout, including verified zero events.
video_window_start_s >=0, end_s > start_s, and 0 <= evaluable_duration_s <= (end_s - start_s); no structural zeros when evaluable duration=0.

For event-to-effort reconciliation, the start/end interval must be contiguous evaluable footage; if there are internal unscorable gaps, split into new observation bouts rather than silently subtracting minutes.

An effort row marked valid_rate_denominator=1 requires: evaluable_duration_s>0; both full approach and head zones filmed; full_continuous_manual OR continuous_algorithm_audited with externally documented, guild-specific recall; complete review; verification URI.
event_triggered_only video cannot provide approach frequency per minute without independently calibrated missed-approach probability; in v1 its rate denominator is always invalid.
zero_approaches_confirmed=1 only with a valid_rate_denominator=1 and zero linked observed approach episodes. Missing events without valid effort are unknown, not zero.
An event observation must match an effort row; its time_from_bout_start_s lies inside the declared reviewed window, otherwise observed entry and visits cannot be assumed complete.

Approach counts must be made from continuous effort where the approach zone is visible. Approach-conditioned service ratios can be reported only for fully scored and taxonomically/behaviorally qualified episodes; unknown role is retained rather than forced to pollinator/antagonist.
Do not use GloBI pollinates or insect taxonomic order as a measure of legitimate pollen deposition or enemy seed saving.
n=0 eligible bout or n=0 observed field events yields NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_REAL_DATA rather than a fabricated biological null.

Plant/head IDs remain the statistical biological units: observed episodes nested in recording bouts nested in head and plant; do not treat 100 encounters on one head as 100 independent reproductive replicates.

Cross-species associational defense (Russell & Louda 2005) is a mandatory rival for apparent focal Cirsium head defenses. Measure other Cirsium species budding/open flower heads within a pre-specified census radius and window; do not regard conspecific heads alone as all floral resources.

When congeneric_resource_census_status=measured, nonnegative integer heads counts, positive radius in metres and citation/field record are required. A true measured zero is the literal '0'. When not assessed, counts/radius/reference stay empty, not zero.

The valid continuous-video approach denominator does not require a congener census; however, a seed-feeder trait-effect claim that disregards available alternative host heads must disclose unresolved associational defense.

identification_targets.estimand: E[number of approaches_g / verified filmed approach-zone minutes] by head/treatment/stage
identification_targets.source: valid effort denominator + observed events; detection recall and within-head correlation addressed
identification_targets.not_valid_when: event-triggered camera footage, off-screen approach area, no guild identification

identification_targets.estimand: P(reproductive zone reached | approached, guild, stage)
identification_targets.source: linked fully reviewed approach events in eligible complete video bouts; route based on actual behavior
identification_targets.not_valid_when: arrival event detection differs by head phenotype or post-arrival capture availability

identification_targets.source: independent pollen assay or directly verified oviposition evidence
identification_targets.not_valid_when: landing only or automated three-order insect ID without behavior

identification_targets.estimand: P(host killed BEFORE seed damage | parasitoid exposure)
identification_targets.source: prospective head/host rearing and independently timed damaging larvae
identification_targets.not_valid_when: parasitoid seen or emergence after head already damaged

identification_targets.estimand: viable achene output by head / total head
identification_targets.source: EAzami original head fate ledger and authorized viability assay
identification_targets.not_valid_when: observation events only, lack of sex-aware and fertilization measures

identification_targets.estimand: focal_head_egg_success ~ measured_phyllary_spines + other_Cirsium_open/bud_heads + phenology + insect host race
identification_targets.source: focal video/head/seed fate linked to contemporaneous heterospecific thistle-head census
identification_targets.not_valid_when: Only focal host morphology and total visitor numbers are recorded or alternate Cirsium counts guessed from the focal species

causal_warning: Conditioning on approached events can select on a post-treatment variable and obscure total effects of head architecture. Report unconditional arrival per valid minute, conditional access/service by verified guild, and total viable achene outcomes as separate estimands. Process-path decomposition is not causal mediation without a justified directed graph/independent interventions. Published associative defense from C. canescens flowering predicted R. conicus eggs on C. undulatum (Russell & Louda 2005, DOI 10.1007/s00442-005-0204-3); other-host flowers can confound a morphological barrier effect.
